about.title: Revital Nznz
text: I design bridal and evening gowns and produce henna nights. What drives me is the moment a bride sees herself in the mirror, or walks into her henna and the whole family rises.
In February 2026 I had the joy of producing my own daughter's henna, straight from Morocco. I bring that same care to every bride who walks into my kingdom.

items.q: How long before the wedding should I come for a fitting?
items.a: For a made-to-measure gown, start a few months ahead so there is time for design and fittings. For a rented evening or henna dress, closer to the date can work too. Revital will plan a schedule with you around your date.

items.q: Rent, buy or made to measure?
items.a: Evening dresses can be rented or bought, bridal gowns are sewn to your wishes, and henna kaftans are rented for the bride, the groom and the family. At the fitting you will hear what suits your event and budget.
Yes, the dress is fitted to you over the fittings. The extent and timing of alterations are agreed at your appointment.

items.q: How many outfits do I need for the henna?
items.a: Some brides wear one outfit, others change several times during the night, and the groom and family can be dressed too. Tell Revital what you imagine and she will suggest a combination.

items.q: Where does Revital produce henna parties?
items.a: Tell us in the form where your event will be, and Revital will get back to you about availability for your date and venue.

items.q: How do I hold my date? Is there a deposit?
items.a: Your date is held once the details are agreed with Revital. The deposit amount and payment method are given when you speak.

bridal.title: A bridal gown sewn for you
bridal.lead: Revital designs bridal gowns in fine tailoring, made to each bride's wishes and led by feeling: lace, tulle, bell sleeves, one shoulder.
body: It starts with a meeting at the showroom: you talk about the event, your style and what moves you. From there you build the dress together and fit until it sits perfectly.
For the henna, you can add a Moroccan outfit from the collection, so the whole look of the big week comes from the same hands.

evening.title: Evening dresses to rent or buy
evening.lead: Gold, silver, lace, capes and split skirts. Designer dresses for the mother of the bride, sisters, friends and every festive night.
body: Each dress in the collection is one of a kind, so you will not meet it on another guest. Rent it for one night or buy it.
Before your fitting, Revital prepares a few dresses based on the colour and size you share with her.

henna.title: Henna dresses and kaftans
henna.lead: Embroidered kaftans, gold capes and red gowns for the henna bride, along with outfits for the groom and the family.
body: Revital's henna styling blends Moroccan tradition with touches of luxury: gold embroidery, stones, rich fabrics and a crown for the bride.
Rent the outfits for the night, or combine them with a full henna production.

production.title: Luxury henna party production
production.lead: A complete Moroccan henna night with personal attention and love for tradition: décor, outfits, handmade cookies and a spice market.
body: Revital builds the night around your concept: from the styled entrance to the talamon, from the henna bowl table to the Moroccan cookies.
Every production is priced personally. Send your date, venue and number of guests, and Revital will come back with a proposal.

footer.photos: All photos on this site come from Revital Nznz's Instagram.

sections.p: This site presents the work and services of Revital Nznz – bridal, evening and henna dress design and henna party production. Contact: +972 52-250-8310.
The forms on this site store nothing. The details you enter go into a WhatsApp message that you send to Revital yourself. The site uses no advertising cookies.
Photos and videos belong to Revital Nznz and the photographers she worked with. Please do not copy them without permission.
Prices, availability and rental terms are given at your appointment and confirmed in writing. Photos show past work and do not guarantee that a specific dress is available.
